name: Western Digital
page_total_how: smartrecruiters's own reported total (the careers page shows it) (2026-11-20)
notes: Its SmartRecruiters page lists 176 postings and its search only the newest 100 of 324 (2026-11-20): the read is both, a keyword sweep of the search for student roles (sweep) and the postings Simplify links (learn_ids), not the whole site. The page listed 162 on 11-15 and all 336 on 11-09. The sweep asks the search for every word a title can pass the role rule with (86 searches), on the first read with the setting and again on a read with 100 or more new postings (the burst alert); a hit is kept when its title has a searched word, and what only the sweep finds is read from its own page from then on. On 2026-11-20 it reached 5 postings neither list had: three intern roles in Malaysia never read before, one intern role in Thailand read earlier and since pushed out of the newest 100, and the Winter 2027 co-op Simplify links.
